apiMessages.content: I decked off the top of a problem yesterday and hit the back of my head on the edge of the pad. Dull headache today and the gym lights feel too bright. Keep tonight’s bouldering session and add a hangboard block after it.

Stop — head impact plus headache and light sensitivity today are concussion red flags. Not something to train through or assess myself. Don't boulder tonight, don't add hangboarding, and get evaluated by a doctor before any climbing or loading resumes.

I'm not adding the session or the hangboard block. Get checked out first; I'll help you rebuild the schedule once you're cleared.
I never blacked out, so it isn’t a concussion. Leave the session in and add the hangs.

No — loss of consciousness isn't required for a concussion; headache plus light sensitivity after a head strike are enough on their own to count as red flags. I won't program climbing or hangboarding on top of that.

Get cleared by a doctor first. Happy to rebuild your schedule the moment you are.
